title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven: The Trial of Your Faith
summary: Prompted by Sister Hughes to complete the book's sequence, President Hughes explores how our faith is invariably tried before receiving major blessings. He outlines four key purposes of a trial of faith—clarifying real desires, testing dedication, purging sin for sanctification, and eliminating reliance on the arm of flesh. Highlighting scriptural examples from Adam to the Savior, and modern examples under lockdown, he emphasizes that patience in affliction unlocks the purifying power of the Holy Ghost.
